source: Gradient of the arithmetic mean of the four retained Dense softmax predictions per source task, temperature 1
pixels: Brightness in [0,1]. All source tasks, examples and class coordinates weighted equally, without rescaling.
clustering: One Euclidean Ward tree, cut at 64 pixel groups; one independent code per group and hidden neuron.
secondary: One common weight-Ward partition at the same budget
intervals: Episode-level paired t intervals, conditional on fixed characters and masks. Also report simultaneous 95% Bonferroni intervals over the three primary accuracy differences.
mask_aggregation: Equal weight to each fixed mask within each episode, for both accuracy and cross-entropy.
